node.title: KoalaBear m2 r8 trivial-stabilizer component payment
node.statement: In the active image of the balanced-core component bridge, every actual residual component of type (m,r,delta)=(2,8,1), equivalently trivial V4 stabilizer, is either excluded or assigned an exact distinct-affine-slope payment with the bridge multiplicity, same received-line owner, and first-match chronology. The theorem prints the total U_trivial.
node.falsifier: A bridge-produced trivial-stabilizer component outside the classification, a surviving component with no exact slope payment, or a payment that changes owner, slope, or multiplicity.
